title: Changing address with Social Security
facts: People receiving Social Security benefits or enrolled in Medicare can generally update their mailing address through applicable Social Security online services or by contacting SSA.
Not every person with a Social Security number needs to report an ordinary residential move to SSA when they are not receiving benefits or services that require a current address.
Address changes do not automatically change direct-deposit bank information; payment information is managed separately.
Some people outside the United States or with certain benefit types may need to use different SSA procedures.
